value.description: Value is the lower-case hex digest.

Checksum.description: Checksum is a content checksum: an algorithm and a lower-case hex value.

apiVersion.description: APIVersion is the document version, "semaphore/v1". Empty means the current version when marshalling.

kind.description: Kind is "Manifest". Empty means "Manifest" when marshalling.

channel.description: Channel names the channel (environment) of the manifest.

generation.description: Generation increases strictly with every publication of a channel, starting at 1.

Manifest.description: Manifest lists the objects of one channel at one generation.

name.description: Name is the logical name, unique in the manifest; flag sets reference objects by it.

kind.description: Kind is KindFlags, KindFlagSets or KindSegments.

connection.description: Connection names a connection of the relay bootstrap file; it fixes endpoint, bucket and credentials.

key.description: Key is the key of the object in the bucket of the connection.

format.description: Format is FormatYAML, FormatJSON or (flags only) FormatTOML.

version.description: Version is the version of the content schema; 0 means ObjectVersion1.

checksum.description: Checksum is the checksum of the exact stored bytes.

size.description: Size is the size of the stored bytes.

versionId.description: VersionID is an optional object version id of the store.

ManifestObject.description: ManifestObject is one source object of a manifest.
